summary: Sound now clears the bar on its own. Both round-4 majors landed. 'Nobody told it... to plan' is the clearest it has been: the envelope evens the take to a 4 dB in-line decay, the line sits 26 dB over the music, and m19 now leaves the line alone. Only a thin tail runs under it, and the floor and E-A swell arrive 0.09 s after 'plan'. The three STATUS: OPEN stamps finally sound, frame-true and in rising strength (-32, -31, -29). The speech compressor is down to 1.7 dB GR. L0220 has its tender pace and its breaths. m01's dead cut sits exactly 0.2 s before 'Our'. The longer credits card is scored as carefully as the rest: a living D under CREDITS, a celesta on SOURCES, and a ring-down to the floor at black. What is left is polish. L0114 still runs at 194 wpm. The how-far stamp's transient lands on the vowel of 'open', the motto's last word, and runs about 6 dB over the voice for roughly 50-100 ms without the fence stamp's under-word limits. The m19 swell after 'plan' jumps 45 dB to -17 M in half a second, which reads more like a sting than a breath after the film's quietest line. m02's X-ray D enters 0.3 s after 'name on it', against the direction to 'let the silence do the work'. L1502's parenthetical 'he wrote' is barely set off (0.14 s), so it can parse as 'the talk he wrote'. No human has listened to the seven names yet.

Alternatively, keep -31 and anchor it at T.wordEnd(L1516b,'open') - 0.05 (about 2104.16), so the clack lands on the word's closing /n/ and rings in the clear (the picture stamp may lead by 0.25 s, which still reads as sync). Keep fx-stamp at -29 as the strongest. Re-mix, then confirm that the 2103.89-2104.21 RMS sits no more than 3 dB over narration+3.6 and that mix.foley passes.

issues.problem: The new Versailles payoff line runs 15.15 s, and its parenthetical gets almost no air: 'talk[0.14] he[0.06] wrote[0.27] nobody'. STT transcribes it without commas as 'whose Versailles talk he wrote nobody he met remembered'. By ear, 'he wrote' can attach to 'talk' (the talk he wrote) rather than read as Hopfield's attribution, which is the nuance the direction protects ('his own claim').

Keep a take with at least 0.3 s before 'he wrote' and at least 0.3 s after it, at 140-150 wpm overall. ch15-s01 re-fits by T.word ('Hopfield', 'Versailles', 'cools'); m19 moves only its post-'downhill' and post-'cools' figures by the delta.
